name: LangChain Academy
summary: Jupyter notebook course for building agents in LangGraph, from setup through deployment across modules 0-6.
description: The repository behind LangChain Academy's Introduction to LangGraph: a growing set of modules (0-6) of Jupyter notebooks, each with a link to its lesson at the top. Module 0 is setup, modules 1-5 build progressively in LangGraph, and module 6 covers deploying agents; each module also has a studio/ folder of graphs for LangGraph Studio. Python 3.11-3.13, with OpenAI, LangSmith and Tavily API keys.
contains: 7 modules (0-6): setup, LangGraph themes, agent deployment
a set of Jupyter notebooks per module, each linked to its LangChain Academy lesson
studio/ folder of graphs per module for LangGraph Studio
setup needs Python 3.11-3.13 plus OpenAI, LangSmith and Tavily keys
